related.title: ITER 國際磁約束研究工程
related.transfer: 可遷移「由融合功率到淨電力」與「中子壁負載」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；ITER 國際磁約束研究工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "From fusion power to net electricity" and "Neutron wall loading" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦由 ITER 到電網：電廠功率平衡、包覆層壽命與更換、氚自給與脈衝運轉的儲熱；ITER 國際磁約束研究工程則以國際熱核融合實驗堆的定量檢核：真空室扇段、七方實物貢獻、分階段運轉與破裂緩解為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on from ITER to the grid: plant power balance, blanket life and replacement, tritium self-sufficiency and thermal storage for pulsed operation; ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering centres on quantitative checks of ITER: vacuum-vessel sectors, in-kind contributions of seven members, staged operation and disruption mitigation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」與「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「磁壓與比壓」的模型移到ITER 國際磁約束研究工程，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「三乘積與點火條件」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Device size and plasma volume" and "Device size and plasma volume".
Move the model of "Magnetic pressure and beta" to ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Triple product and the ignition condition", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「由融合功率到淨電力」與「中子壁負載」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；ITER 國際磁約束研究工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "From fusion power to net electricity" and "Neutron wall loading" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering must be respecified.

related.title: IFMIF-DONES 融合材料中子源
related.transfer: 可遷移「由融合功率到淨電力」與「中子壁負載」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；IFMIF-DONES 融合材料中子源的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "From fusion power to net electricity" and "Neutron wall loading" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of IFMIF-DONES Fusion Materials Neutron Source must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦由 ITER 到電網：電廠功率平衡、包覆層壽命與更換、氚自給與脈衝運轉的儲熱；IFMIF-DONES 融合材料中子源則以以加速器模擬融合中子：五百萬瓦氘束、液態鋰靶、材料損傷累積與可用率為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on from ITER to the grid: plant power balance, blanket life and replacement, tritium self-sufficiency and thermal storage for pulsed operation; IFMIF-DONES Fusion Materials Neutron Source centres on simulating fusion neutrons with an accelerator: a five-megawatt deuteron beam, a liquid-lithium target, accumulating material damage and availability, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」與「五百萬瓦的氘束」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「磁壓與比壓」的模型移到IFMIF-DONES 融合材料中子源，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「材料損傷的累積時間」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Device size and plasma volume" and "A five-megawatt deuteron beam".
Move the model of "Magnetic pressure and beta" to IFMIF-DONES Fusion Materials Neutron Source, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Time to accumulate material damage", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「由融合功率到淨電力」與「中子壁負載」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；IFMIF-DONES 融合材料中子源的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "From fusion power to net electricity" and "Neutron wall loading" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of IFMIF-DONES Fusion Materials Neutron Source must be respecified.

history.title: EU-DEMO 示範融合電廠概念
history.titleEn: EU-DEMO Demonstration Fusion Power Plant Concept
history.text: 2012 年歐洲融合路線圖提出；2014 年概念設計前期研究開始；2020 年通過概念設計前期的關卡審查；2021 年進入概念設計階段。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2012: The European fusion roadmap was issued. 2014: Pre-conceptual design work began. 2020: The pre-concept design gate review was passed. 2021: The concept design phase began. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
